videos.title: And You'll Never Let Anyone Stress You Out Again | Mel Robbins
videos.description:
Saying "let it go" makes you feel like you lost. Saying "let them" makes you feel like you rose above it.

In this clip, Mel Robbins and Jay Shetty talk about the Let Them theory. It starts with a rude boss and a pile of dishes in the sink. But Mel says that's only half of it.

She shares the talk Chris had with her about cardboard boxes and a messy counter. One sentence from him changed how she heard it. She explains why you can't change another person, and what you can do instead. And she gives a 30-day rule for after a breakup.

Learn about the second part of the theory that people never tattoo on themselves. And learn why a simple apology can help someone you love want to change.
